text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 at 25W. These are the ones from the search results.

**Available in the US**

- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh):** It is WPC Qi2.2-certified, with 25W wireless charging and a 45W USB-C port. It recharges at up to 30W. It lists at $79.99 on Amazon US, and Baseus's own store has it at $59.99 ([Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html)). A third-party deal site reports the code AM52 takes $6 off there, bringing it to $53.99. [Buy at Baseus](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. Check the final price at checkout, since codes change.
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10,000 mAh):** It has Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, a built-in cooling fan, a 45W USB-C port, a display, and a stand. It costs $109.99. The page shows it as a pre-order shipping Oct. 21 to Nov. 9, 2026. [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)

**Announced, but I couldn't confirm current US listings**

- **UGREEN MagFlow 25W:** This was the first Qi2.2-certified power bank. UGREEN planned a Q3 2025 launch on Amazon and its own site, but the results show no current price or product page. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html)
- **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh):** At 13.8 mm thick, ESR calls it the thinnest Qi2 25W power bank. ESR's release says "Qi2 25W" rather than naming Qi2.2, and it gives no price or product link. It says the bank is sold on Amazon and ESR's site. [Press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html)

**Probably not sold in the US**

- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro:** It has Qi2.2 25W and a built-in 35W cable. It was released in Japan through Amazon.co.jp and Rakuten. [Press release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html)

**Compatibility:** The 25W speed needs an iPhone 16 or later, except the 16e. Per the Baseus specs on the deal site, it also needs iOS 26, and older iPhones (12 to 15) get 15W. The Notebookcheck article also lists the Pixel 10 Pro XL as a Qi2.2 phone.

If you want the best value, the Baseus PicoGo AM52 is the cheapest confirmed option. The Anker costs more but adds active cooling.
